name: cavemio-input
title: Input
description: A one-line field with a label, hint and error that trade places, a clear button that folds in, and one shake when an error arrives.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Shares field.tsx with every text control: one surface, one focus ring, one way of showing hints and errors.
- Reduced motion: the hint and error change in place and nothing shakes.
- The clear button hands focus back to the field.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: label
props.description: – · Shown above; becomes the accessible name.

props.name: hint
props.description: – · Line under the field while there is no error.

props.name: error
props.description: – · Turns the field red and takes the hint's place.

props.name: leading / trailing
props.description: – · Icon or text before and after the value.

props.name: clearable
props.description: false · A clear button once there is text.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · The new text on every change.

props.name: ...input props
props.description: – · Everything a native input takes, including ref.

useCases.title: Sign-up and settings forms
useCases.description: Name, email and URL fields with hints that turn into errors in place.

useCases.title: Filters above a table
useCases.description: A clearable field that empties with one press.

useCases.title: Inline creation rows
useCases.description: A compact 28px field inside a toolbar or list row.

useCases.title: Domain and handle fields
useCases.description: Leading and trailing text such as https:// or .com.

features.title: Hint and error in one line
features.description: The hint folds away as the error rises out of a blur, and back when it is fixed.

features.title: A clear button that makes room
features.description: It opens its own width as you type, so the text never jumps under it.

features.title: Accessible by default
features.description: Label, aria-invalid and aria-describedby are wired to the right ids.

features.title: Works with any form library
features.description: Controlled or uncontrolled; onChange and onValueChange both fire, even from the clear button.

states.title: rest
states.description: A thin line pill, 36px or 28px tall; hover darkens the line.

states.title: focus
states.description: The line turns to the ring with a 3px halo (200ms).

states.title: typing
states.description: With clearable, a clear button opens its width as the first letter lands (320ms) and folds away when the field is empty.

states.title: error
states.description: The line turns red, the hint folds away while the error rises from a 4px blur (320ms), and the field shakes once (380ms).
